text:
Type: long low chest of eight drawers
Use: storing clothes, linens and media, low top for a TV or decor; bedroom, living room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white matte painted fiberboard, red drawer fronts, black slot grips
Colors: white, bright red accent drawers, black
Shape: long low chest with four columns of two drawers, one column fronted in red, flush handleless fronts with black cut-out grips, flat top, low plinth, broad and low
Feel: crisp, graphic, playful, orderly
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, red or black accents; Scandinavian or modern living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: NORDLI
product.description: You can use one modular chest of drawers or combine several to get a storage solution that perfectly suits your space.
